source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Engine - Engine Mechanical V8, p.6-35

procedures.title: Timing chain and/or sprockets (V8): replace
steps: Pull the cam sprocket onto the camshaft with its 3 bolts and torque them to specifications.
Oil the timing chain with engine oil.
Install the front cover and torsional damper.

procedures.title: Camshaft (V8): measure lobe lift
steps: Set a dial indicator with ball socket adapter J-8520 on the push rod (see figure 25V in the manual).
Slowly turn the damper in the direction of rotation until the lifter is on the heel of the lobe (push rod at its lowest).
Zero the indicator, then turn the damper slowly, or bump the engine with an auxiliary starter switch, until the push rod is fully raised.
Compare the total lift with specifications.
Keep turning until the indicator returns to zero, to confirm the first reading.
If all lobes are within spec, remove the indicator.
notes: If valve operation seems wrong, measure every push rod's lift in order and record the readings; the method is like checking valve timing.
CAUTION: when bumping the engine, disconnect the primary distributor lead from the coil negative post and have the ignition switch ON, or the switch grounding circuit will be damaged.
